# Create Visual Card Output Template

Use this template when handing off a generated visual card. The HTML and PNG paths should point to real files produced in the workspace.

```markdown
# Create Visual Card Delivery

## Content Density
<low / medium / high> — <one sentence reason>

## Layout Choice
<big character / balanced sections / newspaper grid / custom> — <why it fits the content>

## Generated Files
- **HTML**: `<absolute path>`
- **PNG**: `<absolute path>`

## QA Checks
- **Screenshot generated**: yes / no
- **Body text size**: >= 18px / issue
- **Mobile readability**: pass / issue
- **Visual hierarchy**: pass / issue

## Notes
- <any intentional design choice or limitation>
```
